sources.entry: Onloc - Track and share your location in real time. Control and lock stolen or lost phones. (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Onloc API is the self-hostable back-end service for Onloc, an app for tracking and locating your devices.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the back-end for Onloc, a service for tracking and locating devices. It is responsible for storing and retrieving Onloc's data. The README is very brief and does not list specific features beyond the description. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes the wider project as tracking and sharing location in real time, and controlling and locking stolen or lost phones, with source code and clients available. The README gives no detailed API documentation. Installation instructions are referenced but the link is not included in the README text provided.
notable: Back-end for the Onloc device tracking service
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Internet of Things
Listing mentions both source code and client apps for the project
Listing mentions remote locking of lost or stolen phones
caveats: README is minimal; installation instructions are only referenced and not included
Only the back-end is in this repository; clients are separate
